C0013.title: Shanghai Putuo Dismantles Criminal Gang Exploiting Fake Orders to Defraud Platform Subsidies
C0013.summary: In June 2025, Shanghai Putuo police cracked a case involving malicious fake orders to defraud subsidies. The criminal gang infiltrated the backend system of an enterprise internet platform, purchased large quantities of delisted coupons, and obtained platform subsidies through fictitious transactions.
